lines.text: Let us practise some easier ones.
Read the cursive word. Tap the printed word that matches.
Spell bug. Trace each letter of bug.
Spell home. Trace each letter of home.
Spell horse. Look at it and remember it.
Spell wish. Trace each letter of wish.
Trace the small letter h. h is for hat.
Try to stay on the dots. Tap the drop to start over.
Try to stay on the line. Tap the drop to start over.
Write restaurant. We ate at a restaurant. restaurant.
Write the short form of information.
Write the word that means: A word that means the opposite.
Write this sentence. As we left, Jo's dog barked.
Write vegetable. A carrot is a vegetable. vegetable.
